formulas.name: totalDurationOnContacted
formulas.expression:
IF( {!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c} > 0 && {!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c} < 1, "Less than a minute",
IF( FLOOR({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c} / 10080) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c} / 10080)) & IF(FLOOR({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c} / 10080) = 1, " Week ", " Weeks "), "" ) & IF( FLOOR(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 10080) / 1440) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 10080) / 1440)) & IF(FLOOR(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 10080) / 1440) = 1, " Day ", " Days "), "" ) & IF( FLOOR(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 1440) / 60) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 1440) / 60)) & IF(FLOOR(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 1440) / 60) = 1, " Hour ", " Hours "), "" ) & IF( ROUND(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 60), 0) > 0, TEXT(ROUND(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 60), 0)) & IF(ROUND(MOD({!Get_Minute_Values.Time_spent_in_Contacted__c}, 60), 0) = 1, " Minute", " Minutes"), "" ) )
